title: Finite polynomial jets of an etale chart at a rational point
statement: Let k be a field, U a k-scheme [def-pc-scheme], and t:U -> A^n_k an etale k-morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sbc-affine-space], with n >= 0. Let L/k be a field extension and b a point of V=U times_Spec(k) Spec(L) [def-pc-fibre-product] whose structural residue map rho:L -> kappa(b) [def-weil-residue-field] is bijective. Let B=O_(V,b), m its maximal ideal, iota:L -> B the structural scalar map, x_i the pulled-back coordinate germs, c_i=rho^(-1)(residue(x_i)), and z_i=x_i-iota(c_i). Set P=L[T_1,...,T_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], I=(T_1,...,T_n), and f:P -> B the map evaluating T_i at z_i with scalars iota. Then B is Noetherian, I B=m, and for every r >= 0 there is a ring isomorphism e_r:P/I^r -> B/m^r sending the class of a polynomial a to the class of f(a).

proof.text: Base change the chart along $\operatorname{Spec}L\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change] the resulting map $e:U_L\to\mathbf A^n_L$ is etale. The fibre-product definition of affine space identifies this base change with $\mathbf A^n_L$. Put $x=e(b)$, $P=L[X_1,\ldots,X_n]$, $y_i=X_i-c_i$ and $\mathfrak q=(y_1,\ldots,y_n)$. The composite $P\to\mathcal O_{U_L,b}\to\kappa(b)=L$ evaluates $X_i$ at $c_i$; its kernel is the prime corresponding to $x$. Translation $X_i\mapsto y_i+c_i$, inverse $y_i\mapsto X_i-c_i$, shows that this kernel is exactly $\mathfrak q$, with quotient $L$. Thus $x$ has structural residue field $L$, and the actual map $\kappa(x)\to\kappa(b)$ is the identity under these identifications. Set $A=\mathcal O_{\mathbf A^n_L,x}=P_{\mathfrak q}$ and $B=\mathcal O_{U_L,b}$; the affine-stalk localization theorem gives the displayed identification of $A$. The stalk map $\varphi:A\to B$ sends $y_i$ to $t_i-c_i$ and fixes $L$.

source.place: Tag 02GO (lemma-base-change-etale); Tag 01HV (lemma-spec-sheaves); explicit translation and evaluation

proof.text: The field $L$ is Noetherian since its only ideals are $0$ and $L$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian] to $P$ and then [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian] to $P_{\mathfrak q}=A$. Thus $P$ and $A$ are Noetherian. The affine scheme $\mathbf A^n_L=\operatorname{Spec}P$ is locally Noetherian by [pqf-def-locnoeth]. By the definitions of etale and unramified, $e$ is locally of finite type. Apply [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] to $e$: $U_L$ is locally Noetherian. Choose an affine neighbourhood of $b$ in its Noetherian affine cover. Its stalk $B$ is a prime localization of the Noetherian coordinate ring by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization], hence is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian]. Both $A,B$ are local rings, as stalks of schemes; no global finite-type or quasi-compactness hypothesis on $U$ was used.

Etaleness gives flatness and unramifiedness by [def-weil-etale-morphism]. By [def-weil-flat-morphism], the actual local stalk map $\varphi:A\to B$ is flat. Apply the forward implication of [lem-trf-unramified-maximal-ideal-residue-criterion] to $e$ at $b$, using $U_L$ itself as the unramified neighbourhood and the local finite type already checked. It gives $\mathfrak m_A B=\mathfrak m_B$. The residue map is an isomorphism by step 1. The Noetherian hypotheses were checked in step 2, so [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-completion-iso] gives an isomorphism $h:\widehat A\to\widehat B$. Its stated formula on compatible classes is induced by $\varphi$, so $h$ fixes $L$ and takes the completed image of each $y_i$ to that of $t_i-c_i$.

proof.text: Put J=(X_i-c_i) in P. Localization induces an isomorphism P/J^r -> P_J/J^r P_J: after translation every s outside J has nonzero constant term c, and modulo J^r its inverse is c^(-1) times the finite geometric series in 1-s/c. This includes r=0, when both rings are zero. The centered variables generate the maximal ideal of P_J, so its extension is m_B by the unramified maximal-ideal criterion. Thus the centered polynomial map f satisfies I B=m_B.

The completion isomorphism from step 3 carries the extended maximal ideal of the source completion to that of the target: both are the unique maximal ideal by the local-completion theorem. Consequently it carries every power to the corresponding power. Quotient by these powers, using the completion projection's surjectivity and its kernel description, to obtain P_J/J^r P_J = B/m_B^r. Combine with the preceding localization isomorphism and translate variables to obtain e_r. All maps arise from the original stalk map, so e_r([a])=[f(a)]. Equivalently one can prove these finite-level isomorphisms directly by flatness and induction on r, using m_A B=m_B and the isomorphism on residue fields. No power series map, inverse limit uniqueness, or dimension-zero scalar conclusion is asserted here.

theorem rational_point_finite_jets
    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ)
    (t : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) (Spec (.of k))) [Etale t]
    (ht : t ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) (Spec (.of k)) ↘ Spec (.of k)) = p)
    (b : (pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))) : Scheme.{u})) :
    let V : Scheme.{u} := pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))
    let ι : L →+* V.presheaf.stalk b :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of L)).inv ≫
        (pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).appTop ≫
          V.presheaf.germ ⊤ b trivial).hom
    let ρ := (V.residue b).hom.comp ι
    ∀ hb : Function.Bijective ρ,
    let z : Fin n → V.presheaf.stalk b := fun i ↦
      let x := V.presheaf.germ ⊤ b trivial
        ((pullback.fst p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))) ≫ t).appTop
          (AffineSpace.coord (Spec (.of k)) (ULift.up i)))
      x - ι ((RingEquiv.ofBijective ρ hb).symm (V.residue b x))
    IsNoetherianRing (V.presheaf.stalk b) ∧
      Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom ι z) (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars (Fin n) L) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (V.presheaf.stalk b) ∧
      ∀ r : ℕ, ∃ e :
          (MvPolynomial (Fin n) L ⧸ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars (Fin n) L ^ r) ≃+*
            (V.presheaf.stalk b ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (V.presheaf.stalk b) ^ r),
        ∀ f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) L,
          e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ f) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.eval₂ ι z f)
